sql: select cls, count(*) n, sum(yt) yt_sum, sum(anglers) anglers_sum, min(fished_date_doy) min_doy, max(fished_date_doy) max_doy from trips group by cls order by cls
select fished_date_season, min(fished_date_doy), max(fished_date_doy), count(*) from trips group by fished_date_season order by fished_date_season
select cls, sum(yt) yt_sum, sum(anglers) anglers_sum, count(*) n from trips where fished_date_season=1 and fished_date_doy between 45 and 61 group by cls order by cls
select cls, avg(avail_t - fished_date_t) as avg_lag, min(avail_t-fished_date_t) min_lag, max(avail_t-fished_date_t) max_lag, count(*) from trips where fished_date_season=0 group by cls
select fished_date_doy, cls, sum(yt) yt, sum(anglers) ang, count(*) n from trips where fished_date_season=1 and fished_date_doy>=50 group by fished_date_doy, cls order by fished_date_doy desc, cls
select sum(yt) from trips where fished_date_season=1
select fished_date_doy, sum(yt) yt, sum(anglers) ang from trips where fished_date_season in (-1,0) and fished_date_doy between 1 and 100 group by fished_date_doy order by fished_date_doy
select fished_date_doy, cls, sum(yt) yt, sum(anglers) ang from trips where fished_date_season=1 and yt>0 group by fished_date_doy, cls order by fished_date_doy
select index_id, avail_doy, value from climate where avail_season=1 order by avail_doy desc limit 10
select fished_date_doy, sum(yt) yt, sum(anglers) ang, sum(yt)/nullif(sum(anglers),0) rate from trips where fished_date_season in (-1,0) group by fished_date_doy order by fished_date_doy
select cls, sum(yt) yt, sum(anglers) ang, sum(yt)/nullif(sum(anglers),0) rate from trips where fished_date_season in (-1,0) group by cls order by rate desc
select fished_date_doy, sum(yt) yt, sum(anglers) ang from trips where fished_date_season in (-1,0) and fished_date_doy>=280 group by fished_date_doy order by fished_date_doy

select cls,
  count(distinct fished_date_doy) days_with_trips,
  sum(case when yt>0 then 1 else 0 end) rows_nonzero,
  count(*) rows_total,
  avg(yt) avg_yt_per_row,
  avg(anglers) avg_anglers_per_row
from trips where fished_date_season in (-1,0) and cls in ('day_1_5','overnight','three_quarter','hd_pm','hd_am')
group by cls
